blocks.x: Where were you living at that time?
First I lived with my mother-in-law when she came here, 126th Street. Then I lived on 135th Street. And around the corner - (GAP IN TAPE) 2 and T151
Long enough when I had the baby. (LAUGHTER)
Cricket's - I think he's 29. He was born in 1943, 'cause we were down in Cafe Society downtown.
I haven't seen her. My son, he's up in Syracuse.
He's 43 years old, too sharp to look at and nothing but a (Jonah?).
No, Cricket was born in 1929, 1929, now you're getting me all - now you got me going here ... he was born in 1940, March 5th, 1940 or '43. Too old to count now.
